description: Search an existing visual index for the actual visual content of a video or your indexed frame library. Uses Apple Vision OCR, optional Gemini frame descriptions, and optional Gemini semantic embeddings. Returns timestamped structured evidence with local file paths removed; capable clients may present the structured result through their own response surfaces. Set openGallery=true to also write a local HTML gallery and open it in the browser. Query embeddings may call Gemini when configured. This tool never downloads or indexes media, so call indexVisualContent first when no visual index exists. [~1-3s]

openGallery.description: Opt in to save an HTML gallery of the top matches to disk and open it in the default browser. Default false: only structured JSON is returned, no gallery file is written and no browser is launched.

query.description: Visual search query, e.g. 'whiteboard diagram' or 'slide that says title research checklist'

videoIdOrUrl.description: Optional scope for a video that has already been visually indexed

name: searchVisualContent
